systems.name: Cursor
systems.summary: Warm paper canvas #f7f7f4, burnt-orange primary, and a five-color agent-timeline palette.

systems.name: Cutpunk

systems.name: Dodo Payments

systems.name: ElevenLabs

systems.name: Figma
systems.summary: Pure black on white with six pastel content blocks. 86px Figma Sans at weight 340.

systems.name: Framer
systems.summary: A #090909 canvas, 110px display at 0.85 line-height and -5.5px tracking, four-stop gradient accents.

systems.name: Inkeep
systems.summary: Warm-white documentation aesthetic. Neue Haas Grotesk display, blue primary, near-black #231f20 ink.

systems.name: Intercom
systems.summary: Warm linen canvas #f5f1ec, black ink, Fin orange, plus a six-hue report palette.

systems.name: Kast
systems.summary: True-black crypto-card site. Instrument Sans Variable with glow-shadow button hovers.

systems.name: Linear
systems.summary: A #010102 near-void canvas, four stacked surface greys, indigo primary, -3px display tracking.

systems.name: Lovable
systems.summary: Parchment #f7f4ed and an opacity-driven grey scale — every grey is #1c1c1c at a different alpha.

systems.name: Meuze
systems.summary: Data-dark #0b1014 with electric blue CTAs. Geist throughout, 23px card radius against 8px buttons.

systems.name: Modal
systems.summary: Terminal black with a phosphor-green accent, Goga with ss01, and a seven-stop dataviz ramp.

systems.name: Notion
systems.summary: White with navy ink and a full set of pastel card tints — peach, rose, mint, lavender, sky.

systems.name: OpenAI (Dark)
systems.summary: Black canvas, #1f1f1f surfaces, alpha-stepped white ink, and a twelve-hue brand ramp.

mono.fontFamily: SF Mono, Consolas, Liberation Mono, ui-monospace

flagship-composite.source: commissioned photography or a photoreal 3D render
flagship-composite.palette: deep space black warming into amber and gold at the light source
flagship-composite.treatment: an oversized numeral or wordmark integrated into the frame's negative space

gradient-bokeh.source: an abstract, softly blurred color field
gradient-bokeh.palette: one hue per topic, drawn from the brand color families
gradient-bokeh.treatment: heavy blur plus a low-opacity fractal noise texture to prevent flat banding

gradient-streak.source: an abstract diagonal light-streak, sharper and more directional than the bokeh style
gradient-streak.palette: one hue per topic or partner
gradient-streak.treatment: motion-blur-like diagonal bands, partner logo set in white on top

research-collage.source: layered flat-color panels combined with real diagrams, equations, or molecular structures
research-collage.palette: a pastel brand hue paired with cream or off-white panels
research-collage.treatment: editorial poster layout, sometimes a ghosted repeated wordmark in the background

documentary-photo.treatment: full-bleed, no text overlay, no color grading applied on top

systems.name: Pinecone
systems.summary: Pure-white vector-database site. Ultramarine #002bff primary, GT Planar with mono accents.

systems.name: Runway

systems.name: Shopify

systems.name: SoundCloud

systems.name: Spotify
systems.summary: Content-first darkness. #121212 shell, pill-and-circle geometry, green reserved for functional highlights.

systems.name: Stripe
systems.summary: Navy ink on white with a violet primary. Weight-300 display type and blue-tinted multi-layer shadows.

systems.name: Supabase
systems.summary: The green. #3ecf8e on white or #1c1c1c, Circular display, and a wide accent set for docs categories.

systems.name: Superhuman
systems.summary: A white body under a #1b1938 purple gradient hero. Warm cream buttons instead of bright CTAs.

systems.name: Together AI
systems.summary: A pastel-gradient light world for product, #010120 midnight for research. Magenta and orange accents.

systems.name: Vercel
systems.summary: Shadow-as-border: box-shadow 0 0 0 1px replaces every CSS border. Geist with -2.4px display tracking.

systems.name: Warp
systems.summary: Warm near-black rather than cold. Parchment #faf9f6 text, Matter Regular everywhere, almost no color.

systems.name: Wise
systems.summary: Bright green #9fe870 on white, 126px/900 display type, and a full semantic state palette.

ex-pricing-tier.description: Default Pricing tier card. Re-uses feature-card chrome with brand canvas-soft surface.

ex-pricing-tier-featured.description: Featured/highlighted tier — polarity-flipped surface (dark fill + light text in light mode, light fill + dark text in dark mode).

ex-product-selector.description: What's Included summary card — re-purposed for SaaS / B2B verticals (NOT a literal product gallery).

ex-cart-drawer.description: Subscription summary — re-purposed for SaaS / B2B (line items per add-on, not literal cart).

ex-app-shell-row.description: Sidebar nav row inside the App Shell example. Active state uses brand primary as the indicator.

ex-data-table-cell.description: Default data-table th + td chrome. Header uses mono-caps eyebrow typography; body uses body-sm.

ex-auth-form-card.description: Sign-in / sign-up card. Re-uses feature-card chrome with text-input primitives inside.

ex-modal-card.description: Modal dialog surface — same chrome as feature-card with elevated shadow.

ex-toast.description: Toast notification surface — feature-card shape + medium shadow.

systems.name: Wispr Flow
systems.summary: Cream #ffffeb canvas, deep-teal accent, and a Garamond serif pairing. Warm rather than techy.
